local: A chart contract first failed because RHOAI podToPodTLS was enabled while the required database TLS compatibility behavior was absent.
The Argo application contract first failed because catalog workloads could not declare controller-mutated fields to ignore.

live.finding: RHOAI generated an MLMD server TLS config whose repeated MySQL connection block omitted the database TLS options; the metadata gRPC pod crash-looped because MariaDB correctly rejected plaintext.
The first database NetworkPolicy blocked the cross-namespace DSPO health check, and service-ca injection left the workload Application OutOfSync on ConfigMap /data.

security.client_verification: hostname-verified against the injected OpenShift service CA
security.compensating_control: MLMD external routing is disabled and database ingress is restricted while the RHOAI 3.5 pod-to-pod TLS incompatibility is tracked.

proof_model.TDD: The chart compatibility and Argo controller-mutation contracts were captured RED before implementation and pass GREEN.
proof_model.EDD: This manifest records immutable code and image revisions, order identity, lifecycle timing, operator state, TLS negotiation, schema state, and exact cleanup.
proof_model.CDD: Catalog intake, WorkloadSeat, Argo Application, DSPA, service-ca ConfigMap, Service, Secret, and NetworkPolicy contracts are explicit and tested.
proof_model.BDD: Given a clean Arena AgentOps order, Launchpad waits for a current-generation DSPA, the metadata service reaches MariaDB only over verified TLS, and normal reclaim leaves zero residue.
proof_model.CBT: Database TLS, CA injection, MLMD startup, DSPO health checks, Argo drift handling, pipeline API health, pod stability, persistence, and cleanup were validated independently.

limitations: RHOAI 3.5 podToPodTLS remains disabled because its generated MLMD server TLS configuration drops the required database TLS settings. This compatibility workaround must be replaced by an upstream-supported configuration before production.
Per-seat MariaDB transport is enforced and verified, but disabling podToPodTLS means this evidence does not certify encryption for every internal Data Science Pipelines component hop.
The Mortgage AI workload still uses MLFLOW_TRACKING_INSECURE_TLS=true; client trust for the shared MLflow service remains a separate production remediation.
The one-seat 1x.demo Loki/MinIO/NFS logging stack still requires durable object and block storage plus production sizing before five-seat testing.
Public-code access and externally trusted TLS remain separate gates.
This proof does not promote AgentOps beyond its one-seat catalog cap.
